metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Like Ted Lasso, it features an optimistic protagonist and a warm ensemble cast that makes for perfect comfort viewing.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: A fast-paced workplace comedy with high-energy humor similar to Community and New Girl.

metas.name: The Office (US)
metas.description: A staple of 'background' TV with a mockumentary style that viewers of Gogglebox and Silicon Valley will enjoy.

metas.name: Modern Family
metas.description: The chaotic but loving family dynamics mirror the energy found in Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Features dense, meta-humor and a dysfunctional family dynamic that fans of Community and Sunny will appreciate.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A supernatural mockumentary that blends the high-concept absurdity of Dirk Gently with sharp comedy.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A joke-dense workplace sitcom about television production that matches the wit of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: Features the fast-talking, cynical, and highly intelligent insults seen in Silicon Valley and Peep Show.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: An uplifting 'fish out of water' story that provides the same feel-good evolution as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: From the creators of Rick and Morty, offering the same brand of sci-fi chaos and adult animation.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A smart, satirical take on sci-fi and action tropes that fits perfectly with Futurama's sense of humor.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A grounded yet quirky animated family comedy that shares the wholesome vibes of King of the Hill.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A chaotic and hilarious British competition show that provides easy, uplifting entertainment like Gogglebox.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A fun, action-packed anime with a unique family dynamic that matches the adventure and humor of One Piece.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, it balances spectacular action with a deeply kind and funny story.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult British sitcom heavy on pop-culture references, making it a great match for Community fans.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A classic geek-centric British sitcom that fans of Silicon Valley and Peep Show will find relatable.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: Surreal and cynical British comedy about a grumpy bookshop owner, matching the tone of Peep Show.

metas.name: Friday Night Dinner
metas.description: Captures the relentless and awkward family energy found in Malcolm in the Middle.

metas.name: The Inbetweeners
metas.description: A hilarious and often cringe-worthy look at adolescence that aligns with the humor of Peep Show.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern mockumentary with a big heart and relatable characters, perfect for fans of New Girl and Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming and lighthearted ensemble comedy about historical spirits that matches the whimsy of The Good Place.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult classic about a catering team that captures the dry, workplace humor seen in Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: An energetic and surreal friendship comedy that matches the chaotic vibe of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A deadpan musical comedy with a quirky, offbeat style that fans of Dirk Gently will love.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A lighthearted detective show featuring a brilliant bromance and constant jokes, similar to the tone of Scrubs.

metas.name: Resident Alien
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy about an alien trying to fit in, blending the tone of Fallout with quirky detective elements.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that celebrates and spoofs the genre, much like Futurama and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A comedic love letter to sci-fi adventure that will appeal to fans of Futurama and Doctor Who.

metas.name: Galavant
metas.description: A musical comedy set in a fantasy world that captures the fun and adventurous spirit of One Piece.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: High-concept, awkward humor that fans of the 'cringe' in Peep Show and Sunny will find fascinating.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: Created by Bill Lawrence (Scrubs), it features a tight-knit friend group and a similarly lighthearted atmosphere.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A sharp satirical look at corporate life that is as witty and fast-paced as Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: A slacker comedy about three friends that shares the irreverent energy of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Hacks
metas.description: A clever comedy about the comedy world itself, matching the sharp writing of 30 Rock and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A warm, easy-to-watch family sitcom that provides great background comfort like New Girl.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate uplifting reality show, perfect for fans of the gentle humor in Gogglebox.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: A comedy-drama about therapy that balances humor and heart, very much in the vein of Ted Lasso and Scrubs.

metas.name: The Mighty Boosh
metas.description: Surreal, imaginative, and highly musical British comedy that fits the cult-classic vibe of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A hilarious and fast-paced ensemble comedy about teenagers that captures the frantic energy of Malcolm in the Middle.
